definition_en: a material that is burned for heat or power, or to give power to something
core_image: 汽车停在加油站，油枪正往里注油
scene: 这辆车的油箱快空了，得找地方加油。The car is low on fuel and needs to stop.
sceneCN: 这里 fuel 是「燃料」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这辆车的油箱快空了，得找地方加油。

senses.title: Material burned for power
senses.definition: a material such as wood, oil, or gas that is burned to produce heat or power
senses.definitionCN: 木柴、石油或天然气等燃烧后产生热或动力的材料
senses.example: The car is low on fuel and needs to stop.
senses.exampleCN: 这辆车的油箱快空了，得找地方加油。
senses.why: This is the basic material sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是基本的材料义项。

senses.title: Give power to
senses.definition: to give fuel to an engine or vehicle
senses.definitionCN: 为发动机或交通工具提供燃料
senses.example: The plane was fuelled before takeoff.
senses.exampleCN: 飞机起飞前加好了油。
senses.why: The noun became a verb of supplying.
senses.whyCN: 名词转化为表示供给的动词。

senses.title: Make stronger
senses.definition: to make a feeling or situation stronger
senses.definitionCN: 使某种情绪或局势更强烈
senses.example: His words only fuelled the argument.
senses.exampleCN: 他的话只是让争论更激烈。
senses.why: Fuel feeds a fire, and also feeds conflict.
senses.whyCN: 燃料助长火焰，也助长冲突。

intro.en: Fuel came from Old French, with a Latin word for hearth behind it.
intro.cn: fuel 来自古法语，背后是拉丁语中表示壁炉的词。

items.en: Focus meant a hearth or fireplace.
items.cn: focus 意为壁炉或火塘。

items.en: Fouaille named material for a fire.
items.cn: fouaille 指生火用的材料。

items.en: The word entered English as fuel.
items.cn: 这个词以 fuel 进入英语。

items.en: It widened to oil, gas, and other energy sources.
items.cn: 词义扩展到石油、天然气等能源。

items.en: The verb came to mean stirring up feeling.
items.cn: 动词义发展为激起情绪。

note.en: Fuel is compared with look-alike words and words for energy sources.
note.cn: 把 fuel 与形近词以及表示能源的词作比较。

core.en: Material that feeds fire or motion.

definition_en: to do what is required or promised, or to make a hope real
core_image: 医生接过证书，终于实现了多年的梦想
scene: 他最终实现了成为医生的梦想。He finally fulfilled his dream of becoming a doctor.
sceneCN: 这里 fulfill 是「实现」（第 3 个义项）；句意：他最终实现了成为医生的梦想。

derivatives.zh: 自我实现的；自我应验的

senses.title: Do what was promised
senses.definition: to do what you promised or are required to do
senses.definitionCN: 去做自己承诺或必须做的事
senses.example: She fulfilled her promise to visit every week.
senses.exampleCN: 她履行了每周探望的承诺。
senses.why: This is the duty sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是义务层面的义项。

senses.title: Meet a need or rule
senses.definition: to satisfy a need, condition, or standard
senses.definitionCN: 满足需要、条件或标准
senses.example: The design fulfills all safety requirements.
senses.exampleCN: 这个设计符合所有安全要求。
senses.why: Here the object is a condition, not a promise.
senses.whyCN: 这里宾语是条件，而不是承诺。

senses.title: Make a hope real
senses.definition: to make a hope, dream, or aim become real
senses.definitionCN: 使希望、梦想或目标成为现实
senses.example: He finally fulfilled his dream of becoming a doctor.
senses.exampleCN: 他最终实现了成为医生的梦想。
senses.why: This is the hopeful, forward-looking sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是充满希望、面向未来的义项。

intro.en: Fulfill is an old English compound of full and fill.
intro.cn: fulfill 是古英语中 full 与 fill 的复合词。

items.en: Fullfyllan meant to fill up completely.
items.cn: fullfyllan 意为完全装满。

items.en: The form became fulfillen.

items.en: It came to mean carrying out a promise.
items.cn: 它开始表示履行承诺。

items.en: It also meant meeting a condition.
items.cn: 它也意为满足条件。

items.en: The sense of realizing a dream grew.
items.cn: 「实现梦想」的义项发展起来。

note.en: Fulfill is compared with look-alike words and words for completing.
note.cn: 把 fulfill 与形近词以及表示完成的词作比较。

entries.definition: to pass liquid through a screen
to meet a need or wish
to succeed in reaching a goal

normalIntro.en: To fulfill is to fill a promise or a dream until it is full.
normalIntro.cn: fulfill 就是把承诺或梦想填满，直到成真。

normal.en: He finally fulfilled his dream of becoming a doctor.
normal.cn: 他最终实现了成为医生的梦想。

normal.en: She fulfilled her promise to visit every week.
normal.cn: 她履行了每周探望的承诺。

normal.en: The design fulfills all safety requirements.
normal.cn: 这个设计符合所有安全要求。

normal.en: The shop fulfills orders within two days.
normal.cn: 这家店两天内完成订单。

normal.en: He felt his work was fulfilling.
normal.cn: 他觉得自己的工作很有满足感。

abstract.en: A promise is a debt that only action can pay.
abstract.cn: 承诺是只有行动才能偿还的债。

abstract.en: A dream fulfilled often looks like ordinary work done daily.
abstract.cn: 实现的梦想常常看起来像每天做的普通工作。

abstract.en: Fulfillment comes from finishing what matters.
abstract.cn: 满足感来自完成真正重要的事。

examples.en: He finally fulfilled his dream of becoming a doctor.

dict_mnemonic.text: fulfill = full（满）+ fill（填）；英式拼写也可作 fulfil，名词是 fulfillment。

root: 源自古英语 fullfyllan，由 full（满）与 fill（填）组成；核心义「填满、完成」。

sensesIntro.en: Fulfill means keeping a promise, meeting a requirement, or making a dream real.
sensesIntro.cn: fulfill 意为履行承诺、满足要求，或使梦想成真。

core.en: Filling something until it is complete.
core.cn: 把某物填满直至完成。

branches.en: A promise is kept by doing it.
branches.cn: 承诺靠行动来兑现。

branches.en: A rule is met by meeting its terms.
branches.cn: 通过满足条款来符合规则。

branches.en: A long hope finally becomes real.

branches.en: Promises and conditions both demand completion.

branches.en: Meeting each requirement allows the dream.

intro.en: Fulfill forms words for completion and satisfaction.

definition_en: holding as much as possible, complete, or having eaten enough

scene: 杯子已经满了，别再倒了。The glass is full, so stop pouring.
sceneCN: 这里 full 是「满的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：杯子已经满了，别再倒了。

senses.definitionCN: 容纳或装着尽可能多的东西

senses.exampleCN: 杯子已经满了，别再倒了。

definition_en: completely, in detail, or at least a stated amount

senses.title: Completely
senses.definition: completely, with nothing missing or doubtful

senses.why: This is the main adverb sense.

definition_zh: 毛皮；软毛；（舌面上的）舌苔
definition_en: the soft thick hair covering an animal, or the skin with this hair used for clothing
core_image: 一件厚实的毛皮大衣挂在冬日的衣架上
scene: 她穿着一件厚厚的毛皮大衣。She wore a thick fur coat.
sceneCN: 这里 fur 是「毛皮」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她穿着一件厚厚的毛皮大衣。

senses.title: Animal skin with hair
senses.definition: the skin of an animal covered with soft hair, often used to make clothes
senses.definitionCN: 覆盖着软毛的动物皮，常用来做衣服
senses.example: She wore a thick fur coat.
senses.exampleCN: 她穿着一件厚厚的毛皮大衣。
senses.why: This names the dressed skin used for warmth.
senses.whyCN: 这是做衣服御寒的带毛兽皮。

senses.title: Soft body hair
senses.definition: the soft thick hair that covers the body of many animals
senses.definitionCN: 覆盖在许多动物身上的浓密软毛

senses.exampleCN: 这只猫有一身柔软的白毛。
senses.why: The word also names the hair itself.

senses.title: Coating on the tongue
senses.definition: a white or yellowish coating that sometimes forms on the tongue
senses.definitionCN: 舌面上有时形成的一层白色或淡黄色覆盖物
senses.example: The doctor noticed a white fur on his tongue.
senses.exampleCN: 医生注意到他舌头上有一层白苔。

intro.en: Fur came into English from Old French, naming a lining of animal skin.
intro.cn: fur 经古法语进入英语，原指用兽皮做的衬里。

items.en: Fourrer meant to line or sheath with fur.

items.en: The noun fur named the animal skin.
items.cn: 名词 fur 指带毛的兽皮。

items.en: It also came to name soft body hair.
items.cn: 它也开始指动物身上的软毛。

items.en: The fur trade shaped early northern economies.
items.cn: 毛皮贸易塑造了北方早期的经济。

items.en: Doctors borrowed the word for a coated tongue.
items.cn: 医生借这个词指舌面上的苔。

note.en: Fur is compared with look-alike words and words for animal coverings.

normalIntro.cn: fur 是让动物和人保暖的柔软外衣。

normal.en: The cat has soft white fur.

normal.en: The doctor noticed a white fur on his tongue.

normal.en: The fur trade once brought great wealth north.

abstract.cn: 外在的柔软可以掩藏内里的艰苦。

core.en: A soft coat that shelters a body.

definition_zh: 熔炉；暖气炉；极热的地方

senses.title: Chamber of great heat

senses.example: Iron is melted in a hot furnace.

definition_en: in addition to what has just been said, used to add another point
core_image: 一段论证之后又添上一个更有力的理由
scene: 这个方案便宜；此外，它还很安全。The plan is cheap; furthermore, it is safe.
sceneCN: 这里 furthermore 是「此外」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这个方案便宜；此外，它还很安全。

senses.title: Adding a point
senses.definition: used to introduce another point that supports what was said
senses.definitionCN: 用来引出另一个支持前文的论点
senses.example: The plan is cheap; furthermore, it is safe.
senses.exampleCN: 这个方案便宜；此外，它还很安全。
senses.why: This is the main linking sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是主要的连接义项。

senses.title: Building an argument
senses.definition: used to strengthen an argument by adding a reason
senses.definitionCN: 通过补充理由来加强论证
senses.example: The room was small; furthermore, it was dark.
senses.exampleCN: 房间很小；而且，它还很暗。
senses.why: The added point pushes the argument forward.
senses.whyCN: 补充的论点把论证向前推进。

senses.title: Formal emphasis
senses.definition: used in formal writing to add emphasis to a further point
senses.definitionCN: 在正式写作中用来强调进一步的论点
senses.example: She was tired; furthermore, she had no money.
senses.exampleCN: 她累了；再者，她也没有钱。
senses.why: The word often marks a formal list of reasons.
senses.whyCN: 这个词常标志正式的理由罗列。

intro.en: Furthermore is a compound of further and more, both old English words.

items.en: Furthur meant further or more distant.

items.en: Further grew to mean additional.
items.cn: further 逐渐表示额外的。

items.en: More was joined to form furthermore.

items.en: It became a formal linking adverb.
items.cn: 它成为正式的连接副词。

note.en: Furthermore is compared with look-alike words and other linking adverbs.

abstract.en: Further and more are two steps in one direction.

definition_en: unnecessary excitement, worry, or activity about something small
core_image: 一家人为一道小划痕忙作一团
scene: 一道小划痕不值得这么大惊小怪。A small scratch is not worth all this fuss.

senses.title: Needless excitement
senses.definition: too much excitement or worry about something unimportant
senses.definitionCN: 对不重要的事情表现出过多的激动或担心
senses.example: A small scratch is not worth all this fuss.
senses.exampleCN: 一道小划痕不值得这么大惊小怪。
senses.why: This is the central sense of needless worry.
senses.whyCN: 这是表示不必要担心的核心义项。

senses.title: Busy movement

definition_zh: 获得；增加；收益；（钟表）走快
definition_en: to get something useful, to increase in amount, or an increase or profit
core_image: 天平上的砝码一点点增加
scene: 她通过实习获得了宝贵的经验。She gained valuable experience through the internship.
sceneCN: 这里 gain 是「获得」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她通过实习获得了宝贵的经验。

senses.title: Obtain something useful
senses.definition: to obtain something valuable through effort
senses.definitionCN: 通过努力得到有价值的东西
senses.example: She gained valuable experience through the internship.
senses.exampleCN: 她通过实习获得了宝贵的经验。
senses.why: This is the core sense of earning something.
senses.whyCN: 这是通过努力得到某物的核心义项。

senses.title: Increase in amount
senses.definition: to increase in weight, speed, or amount
senses.definitionCN: 在重量、速度或数量上增长
senses.example: He gained five kilos during the winter.
senses.exampleCN: 他冬天重了五公斤。
senses.why: The word covers growth as well as earning.
senses.whyCN: 这个词既涵盖获得也涵盖增长。

senses.title: Profit or increase
senses.definition: an increase in money, advantage, or value
senses.definitionCN: 金钱、优势或价值上的增长
senses.example: The company reported a small gain this year.
senses.exampleCN: 公司今年报告了小幅收益。
senses.why: As a noun it names the increase itself.
senses.whyCN: 作名词时它指增长本身。

senses.title: Run fast by a clock
senses.definition: to run ahead of the correct time, used of a clock
senses.definitionCN: 指钟表比正确时间走得快
senses.example: The old clock gains three minutes a day.
senses.exampleCN: 这座旧钟每天快三分钟。
senses.why: A clock gains time as money gains value.
senses.whyCN: 钟表增加时间，如同金钱增加价值。

intro.en: Gain came from Old French, naming the profit of effort.
intro.cn: gain 来自古法语，指努力所得的收益。

items.en: Gaaignier meant to earn or win.
items.cn: gaaignier 意为赚取或赢得。

items.en: The word entered English as gain.
items.cn: 这个词以 gain 进入英语。

items.en: It covered both earning and growing.

items.en: Finance gave the noun a profit sense.

items.en: Clocks gain time when they run fast.
items.cn: 钟表走快时被说成 gain time。

note.en: Gain is compared with look-alike words and words for getting or profit.

normal.en: The company reported a small gain this year.

normal.en: The old clock gains three minutes a day.

normal.en: You gain nothing by waiting.

abstract.en: No pain, no gain is a hard but honest rule.
abstract.cn: 不劳无获是一条严酷却诚实的规则。

abstract.en: We gain most when we give something away.
abstract.cn: 我们付出时得到的往往最多。

abstract.en: Time is the one gain no clock can hold.
abstract.cn: 时间是任何钟表都留不住的一笔所得。

root: 经古法语 gaaignier（赚取、赢得）进入英语，核心义「通过努力使所得增加」。

sensesIntro.en: Gain means obtaining something, increasing, making a profit, or running fast of a clock.
sensesIntro.cn: gain 指获得某物、增加、取得收益，或钟表走快。

core.en: To end up with more than before.
core.cn: 最终拥有比之前更多。

branches.en: Work turns into useful experience.
branches.cn: 工作转化为有用的经验。

branches.en: Weight and speed can grow.

branches.en: Money shows a rise on the page.

branches.en: A clock runs ahead of true time.

intro.en: Gain builds words for earning, increase, and recovery.
intro.cn: gain 构成表示赚取、增长和重新获得的词。

definition_en: a room or building where art is shown, or a long raised area in a hall or theatre
core_image: 白墙上挂满画作的长廊
scene: 我们整个下午都在画廊里看画。We spent the afternoon looking at paintings in the gallery.
sceneCN: 这里 gallery 是「画廊」（第 1 个义项）；句意：我们整个下午都在画廊里看画。

senses.title: Place showing art
senses.definition: a room or building where paintings and other art are shown
senses.definitionCN: 展出绘画和其他艺术品的房间或建筑
senses.example: We spent the afternoon looking at paintings in the gallery.
senses.exampleCN: 我们整个下午都在画廊里看画。
senses.why: This is the common modern sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是现代常见的义项。

senses.title: Raised seats in a theatre
senses.definition: the highest area of seats in a theatre or hall
senses.definitionCN: 剧院或礼堂中最高的座位区
senses.example: Their cheap seats were high in the gallery.
senses.exampleCN: 他们的便宜座位在很高的楼座上。
senses.why: The old raised walkway became a seating area.
senses.whyCN: 旧时的高架通道变成了座位区。

senses.title: Long covered walk
senses.definition: a long narrow room or covered walk along a wall
senses.definitionCN: 沿墙延伸的狭长房间或有顶通道
senses.example: A gallery runs along the north wall.
senses.exampleCN: 一条长廊沿着北墙延伸。
senses.why: This is the older architectural sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是较早的建筑义项。

intro.en: Gallery came through French from a Latin word for a covered walk.
intro.cn: gallery 经法语来自拉丁语中表示有顶通道的词。

items.en: Galeria meant a covered walk.
items.cn: galeria 意为有顶的通道。

items.en: Galleries became rooms for showing art.

items.en: The theatre sense kept the raised idea.
items.cn: 剧院义保留了「高起」的含义。

core.en: A long space made for looking or passing along.

branches.en: Paintings line a white wall.

definition_zh: 加仑（容量单位）；一加仑的量；大量
definition_en: a unit for measuring liquid, about four and a half litres in Britain or about three point eight litres in the United States
core_image: 一大桶牛奶上标着容量刻度
scene: 他买了一加仑牛奶带回家。He bought a gallon of milk and took it home.
sceneCN: 这里 gallon 是「加仑」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他买了一加仑牛奶带回家。

senses.title: Unit of liquid measure
senses.definition: a unit for measuring liquid, with different sizes in Britain and America
senses.definitionCN: 测量液体的单位，在英国和美国大小不同
senses.example: He bought a gallon of milk and took it home.
senses.exampleCN: 他买了一加仑牛奶带回家。
senses.why: This is the standard measuring sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是标准的计量义项。

senses.title: Amount held by one gallon
senses.definition: the amount of liquid that fills a gallon container
senses.definitionCN: 装满一加仑容器所需的液体量
senses.example: The engine used half a gallon on the short trip.
senses.exampleCN: 这段短途行程发动机用了半加仑。
senses.why: The unit also names the quantity itself.
senses.whyCN: 这个单位也指数量本身。

senses.title: A great deal
senses.definition: a very large amount, used informally in the plural
senses.definitionCN: 非正式用语，复数形式表示非常大的量
senses.example: Gallons of water poured through the roof.
senses.exampleCN: 大量的水从屋顶灌下来。
senses.why: The container size became a picture of plenty.
senses.whyCN: 容器的容量变成了「很多」的形象。
